The 2,400-hour hash contract has no literal expected value in the repository: strategic_determinism.rs states it relationally (two runs of seed 7 must agree; a save at hour 1,200 must reach the same hash at 2,400; any pause interleaving must be byte-identical). The islands did move -- buildings finish now and machines drink -- and all four hash claims plus the honest negative authored_hash == empty_hash still hold, so there was no value to update: passed

Said plainly: nothing on the authored island produces resource.open.fuel or resource.open.water, so every AUTHORED machine starves the hour after it is built and the journal says so. S17's trickle fills resource.open.gathered and one key only. The M3 probe therefore adds one fixture machine record burning that key (the_authored_machines_and_one_that_burns_what_this_island_gathers) and places one machine by hand (a_standing_machine), both named in the test, because no faction but Michael's can build a machine at all. An income lane, or a captured cell that hands something over, is what makes an authored machine's upkeep bite on the real island: not_run
